title: One owned thing: omitting meidän and teidän
focus: Leave out meidän or teidän while keeping the noun ending; retain heidän with singular possessed nouns.
targetSkills: Possessive pronoun omission and clear reference

exercises.prompt: Write “This is your car.” in Finnish. Begin with Tämä on. Address a group. Leave out teidän; keep the noun ending. Use auto (“car”).
exercises.explanation: Tämä on identifies one thing. The ending -nne identifies your ownership. Teidän can be omitted because the ending identifies the owner; the suffix stays.
requiredSkills: Possessive pronoun omission and clear reference
exercises.targetSkill: Possessive pronoun omission and clear reference
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Possessive pronoun omission and clear reference: form or meaning confused

parts.formation: Tämä identifies one thing.
